hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" | grep -q '^frontend/'; then cd frontend && npx eslint "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" --max-warnings 0 2>/dev/null; fi
if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" | grep -q '^backend/.*\.py$'; then cd backend && uv run ruff check "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null; fi
if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" | grep -q '^ingestion/.*\.ts$'; then cd ingestion && npx eslint "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null; fi
